description: Bramble THE ROLL-OVER property (M2 set piece #2, worlds/bramble/rollover_sequence.gd; D25 THE REVEAL extends it), driven by --rollover (dev/capture force-arm, fires ~3s after load regardless of dream count -- ROLLOVER {"forced":true}). No input needed: both Pip and Otto sit at their spawns until the sequence bubble-lifts them (core/rescue/bubble_effect.gd, which prints no receipt of its own -- watch the PLAYER_POS trajectory instead). Expected receipts, in order: ROLLOVER phase=start (forced:true); BREATH phase=force_gust then exhale_start (breath_weather.gd's D25 public API, fired right after the letterbox comes in); the far meadow's collision/visual going live immediately (no fall-through gap); a multi-second PLAYER_POS float of both seats from spawn to the far meadow landing pad (~x=-20/-18.6, z=-52); ROLLOVER phase=keystone clip=wake, immediately followed by DRESSING phase=reveal_start/clouds_blown/debris_falling (mountain_dressing.gd's cloud-ring-then-prop-fall choreography, timed to land during the wake clip per D25); ROLLOVER phase=keystone clip=breathe, then clip=toss_turn; ROLLOVER phase=end; and PLAYER_POS lines for both seats holding steady on solid far-meadow ground afterward -- never a RESCUE line (that would mean a player fell through into the generic rescue net instead of landing on the new ground). Stills for the child-would-not-know verdict: evidence/stills/m3_mountain/v4_wide_disguised (before), reveal2/shot_400 or reveal/shot_240 (mid-reveal, clouds/debris), reveal/shot_900 (revealed, mid toss_turn) -- see docs/verify/mountain-m3-VERIFY.md.
